description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing patient profiles, including CRUD operations with RBAC enforcement, connecting to a MongoDB database.

classes.name: PatientCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new patient.

classes.name: PatientUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating existing patient data.

methods.name: Patient _patient_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB document to a Patient model instance.

methods.name: None _assert_patient_owner_or_admin( patient_doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to act on the patient document.

methods.name: List[Patient] list_patients(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin", "doctor"])))
methods.description: Lists all patient profiles, accessible to admins and doctors.

methods.name: Patient create_patient( payload: PatientCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Creates a new patient profile with RBAC enforcement.

methods.name: Patient get_patient( patient_id: str = Path(..., description="Patient document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a patient profile by ID with RBAC enforcement.

methods.name: Patient update_patient( patient_id: str, payload: PatientUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
None delete_patient( patient_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a patient profile, admin only.

ctags.name: get_patient

ctags.signature: ( patient_id: str, payload: PatientUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
